pages.en: It's Sam's party today. Lily opens her cupboard. "What shall I wear?" she asks. She tries on a skirt, then a dress, then her jeans.
pages.zh: 今天是 Sam 的聚会。Lily 打开衣柜问：“我穿什么好呢？”她试了一条半身裙，又试了一条连衣裙，然后是她的牛仔裤。
pages.scene: Lily in her bedroom in front of an open cupboard, clothes all over the bed: a skirt, a dress and jeans, Lily holding up a dress and thinking.

pages.en: Tom is ready. He wears his lion costume! "It's not a costume party, Tom," Lily laughs. But Tom doesn't want to take it off.
pages.zh: Tom 已经准备好了，他穿着狮子服！“这不是化装聚会，Tom。”Lily 笑着说。可是 Tom 不想脱下来。
pages.scene: Tom proudly standing in his fluffy lion costume with the mane hood, roaring, Lily laughing in the doorway.

pages.en: In the end, Lily wears her blue dress and a pretty bracelet. Tom wears his lion costume. At the party, everyone loves Tom's costume!
pages.zh: 最后，Lily 穿上了蓝色连衣裙，戴了一条漂亮的手链。Tom 穿着他的狮子服。在聚会上，大家都很喜欢 Tom 的服装！
pages.scene: At a birthday party with balloons: Lily wearing a pretty sky-blue party dress and a beaded bracelet, standing next to Tom wearing his fluffy lion costume, children and Sam laughing and clapping around them.

questions.q: Lily wears her jeans to the party.
questions.zh: Lily 穿着牛仔裤去参加聚会。
